title: Asana cleared 5 years of engineering work in 2 weeks with Codex
summary: Asana used OpenAI Codex to replace an outdated testing system in two weeks, completing work expected to take five years for about $12K.
body: Asana used OpenAI Codex to replace an outdated testing system in two weeks, completing work expected to take five years for about $12K.
summaryZh: 协同软件公司Asana近期利用OpenAI Codex，在短短两周内成功完成了原本预计需要五年工程量的大规模测试系统重构。该项目不仅大幅提效，总成本也控制在约1.2万美元左右，生动体现了大语言模型在企业级复杂软件工程中的巨大落地价值与生产力变革。
